purpose: Twenty style-diverse, license-documented recordings for visual stress testing of the building generator. One additional Mozart recording is retained as an auxiliary comparison because its hosted CC0 declaration is less conclusive about the underlying performance rights.
license_scope: CC0 declarations and CC BY 4.0 declarations recorded on the linked source pages; this is a research provenance record, not a legal opinion.

tracks.title: Symphony No. 29 in A major, K. 201 (first-movement excerpt)
tracks.license_basis: Commons page identifies the Mozart composition and the uploaded performance; CC0 is attached to the file page.
tracks.verification: downloaded; ffprobe decodes Ogg Vorbis; non-HTML media
tracks.rights_review: Auxiliary only: the source page declares the hosted file CC0, but the underlying performance provenance is less explicit than the author-originated recordings below.
